mapper.select: SELECT MAX( CAST( SUBSTRING(order_no, 11) AS UNSIGNED -- 从第9位开始截取数字部分 ) ) AS max_seq FROM inbound_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() -- 当天 AND order_no LIKE CONCAT('RK', DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d'), '%');
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inbound_order (order_no, type, warehouse_id, supplier_id, operator_id, total_amount, status, remark, create_time) values (#{orderNo},#{type},#{warehouseId},#{supplierId},#{operatorId},#{totalAmount},#{status},#{remark},#{createTime})
